The '''ETX Mk I Etheric Rudder''' was a type of [[etheric rudder]] built into a vehicle to enhance the maneuverability of the craft. It was manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EV" />
